package.description: Cross-agent state portability for AI coding agents.

en-US.description: Cross-agent state portability for AI coding agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Aplexica is cross-agent state portability software. Your memories, skills,
tools, and conversation history are portable across every AI coding agent
you use, with deterministic lossless replication - no LLM summarization.
The OSS daemon (aplexicad) is local-only: it binds to 127.0.0.1, never
calls out to the network, and the canonical store lives in ~/.aplexica/.
en-US.name: Aplexica
